svg.title: Agentic token lifecycle (as described, not a published state model)
svg.desc: State diagram: Agentic token lifecycle (as described, not a published state model). 8 states: Agent registered, Agent certified, Consumer authorized, Token provisioned, Presented at checkout, Authorized, Declined, and Expired or no longer usable. Starts in Agent registered. Ends in Authorized, Declined, and Expired or no longer usable. 8 transitions. From Agent registered to Agent certified when Security review and certification pass. From Agent certified to Consumer authorized when Consumer authenticates with the platform and authorizes the agent. From Consumer authorized to Token provisioned when Platform requests an agentic token (Not published). From Token provisioned to Presented at checkout when Agent fills the card form or calls the merchant API. From Presented at checkout to Authorized when Network detokenizes and issuer approves (Card authorization message). From Presented at checkout to Declined when Outside token limits or issuer declines (Card authorization message). From Token provisioned to Expired or no longer usable when Time window passes or single use consumed. From Authorized to Expired or no longer usable when Single-use token cannot be used again.
